title: Forest Wide Decommissioning Project
agency: AGRICULTURE, DEPARTMENT OF > FOREST SERVICE > USDA-FS, CSA SOUTHWEST 7
description:
AMENDMENT 0001 - Extends Offer Due Date to December 7th, 2026 @1300 Central Time 

  

 The Tonto National Forest is looking to achieve a more sustainable recreation program. Through this project, several recreation areas will be decommissioned in the Tonto Basin Ranger District (RD), and Globe RD. The decommission of campgrounds at the Tonto Bassin RD is the base bid and at Globe RD, it is an option bid. The intent of this work is to remove and safely dispose outside of the National Forest boundaries, recreational accommodations that include but not limited to Entry station buildings, toilets buildings, sidewalks, asphalt pavement, fish cleaning stations, septic system, and parking lots.
